title: 第5章 炼丹房 上第6章 炼丹房 下
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
日出东方，天刚蒙蒙亮。
秦莲川的身子贴着石长捷的大腿柔声蜜语。
“石长老，那日在沐府我的本命法宝……”
石长捷整理好衣裳搂住秦莲川的腰间，拿出一块精炼玄铁放在她雪白的颈肩。
“你才筑基，丢了便丢了，金丹之前再祭炼一把便是，这块玄铁极好，赠与你罢。”
秦莲川媚笑一声，躬身谢礼。
“李寻机，要你办的事儿怎么样了？”
“弟子按照您的吩咐派人盯着张大虎一举一动。”
这时秦莲川附和道：“这张大虎不识抬举，您招他入外门弟子胆敢拒绝，不如我帮您解决了他？”
“不着急，留着他还有用。”
此时门外。
石问天被看门弟子拦住生气往回走。
“这算什么老祖，想见见不着，有事也说不上，除了我弄进外门弟子，别的都指望不上！”
与此同时，林江月被赵听白押到饭堂烧火做饭。
“林师妹，没事的，今天就煮些灵米饭，其它的不做也罢。”赵听白松开手一脸急迫。
她从前最烦的就是赶鸭子上架吃力不讨好。
她不是怕自己烧不好。
她是怕烧好了会影响张大虎的前程，毕竟抢师父饭碗的徒弟，没一个好活的。
更何况张大虎人还挺好的，她更不想惹事。
林江月灵机一动，眼睛一闭，身子一软，倒在地上。

赵听白见状，人都吓傻了，赶忙查看林江月鼻息。
林江月也不是吃素的，装作身体虚弱，慢慢悠悠的说道。
“我灵力不够，怕是心有余……而力不足……”
“你拿些灵石顶顶啊！”赵听白气急败坏转了语气，“平时不好好练功，关键时刻误事！”
林江月听了这话白眼一翻，脑袋一歪。
碰瓷谁不会啊，老娘见过的老赖数不胜数！
“喂！你这是什么意思？装死是不是？”赵听白怒目而视。
“你你你，我要去内务堂告你们师徒的状。”赵听白见林江月使唤不动，摆手就走出后厨。
你别说，还真别说。
这要是别的炼气期弟子硬上也就上了，可谁让赵听白遇上的是林江月。
人倒霉喝凉水都塞牙缝。
还没踏出门赵听白就被张大虎逮住。
“赵听白！平时见你好声好气，趁我不在，欺负我徒弟，是不是？”
张大虎拿出“痒痒挠（不求人）”，举过头顶，周身随着一阵风蓄势待发。
“张师兄息怒，我也是为了饭堂名声，烧不出饭，内务堂掌事肯定要责罚我。”
content_en:
The sun rises in the east, and the sky is just bright.
Qin Lianchuan pressed his body against Shi Changjie's thigh and whispered sweetly.
"Elder Shi, my natal magic weapon that day in Mu Mansion..."
Shi Changjie arranged his clothes and put his arms around Qin Lianchuan's waist, then took out a piece of refined black iron and placed it on her snow-white neck and shoulders.
"You just built the foundation. If you lose it, throw it away. Just sacrifice it before refining the golden elixir. This piece of black iron is very good. I'll give it to you."
Qin Lianchuan smiled charmingly and bowed to thank him.
"Li Xunji, how's the matter going for you?"
"Disciple, follow your instructions and send someone to watch Zhang Dahu's every move."
At this time, Qin Lianchuan echoed: "This big tiger doesn't know how to be praised. You dare to refuse to recruit him as an outer disciple. How about I help you deal with him?"
"Don't worry, keeping him is still useful."
At this time, outside the door.
Shi Wentian was stopped by the gatekeeper and walked back angrily.
"What kind of ancestor is this? I can't see you if I want to, and I can't tell you anything. Except for me to get the outer disciples, I can't hope for anything else!"
At the same time, Lin Jiangyue was escorted by Zhao Tingbai to the canteen to cook.
"Junior sister Lin, it's okay. I'm just going to cook some spiritual rice today, and don't do anything else." Zhao Tingbai let go of his hand with a look of urgency.
What bothered her most in the past was that it was a thankless job to get the ducks on the shelves.
She was not afraid that she would not be able to burn properly.
She was afraid that burning it would affect Zhang Dahu's future. After all, no apprentice who stole his master's job would have a good life.
What's more, Zhang Dahu is quite nice, and she doesn't want to cause trouble.
Lin Jiangyue had an idea, closed her eyes, softened and fell to the ground.
Zhao Tingbai was frightened when he saw this, and hurriedly checked Lin Jiangyue's breathing.
Lin Jiangyue was not a vegetarian, so she pretended to be weak and spoke slowly.
"I don't have enough spiritual power. I'm afraid I have more than enough heart...but not enough strength..."
"Get some spiritual stones to support you!" Zhao Tingbai changed his tone angrily, "If you don't practice well at ordinary times, you will make mistakes at critical moments!"
Lin Jiangyue rolled her eyes and tilted her head after hearing this.
Who doesn’t know how to touch porcelain? I’ve seen countless old gangsters!
"Hey! What do you mean? Are you pretending to be dead?" Zhao Tingbai glared angrily.
"You, you, you, I'm going to the Internal Affairs Hall to sue you as master and disciple." Zhao Tingbai waved his hand and walked out of the kitchen when Lin Jiangyue couldn't do anything.
Don't say it, really don't say it.
It would have been easy for other Qi Refining Stage disciples to do this, but who made Zhao Tingbai meet Lin Jiangyue.
People are unlucky enough to have cold water stuck between their teeth.
Zhao Tingbai was caught by Zhang Dahu before he even stepped out of the door.
"Zhao Tingbai! I usually see you being so loud and angry, but you bully my apprentice while I'm away, right?"
Zhang Dahu took out "Itchy Scratch (Don't Ask for Help)" and raised it above his head, with a gust of wind all over his body ready to go.
"Senior Brother Zhang, calm down. I am doing this just for the reputation of the canteen. If I can't cook any food, the head of the Internal Affairs Hall will definitely punish me."
